reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Reconcile heterogeneous client assessment evidence into a validated report-data contract, then delegate deterministic document rendering to an isolated and verified renderer.
neutralIntentExamples: render a verified client assessment report from a validated evidence contract
turn client-scoped audit data into a checked document without inventing missing scores
operations: discover client-scoped evidence, parse scores and findings, preserve missing dimensions, validate a bounded data structure, render, and verify the resulting document
outputs: validated report data, rendered client document, source index, and rendering receipt
failureBehavior: retain validated report data and expose the exact renderer or dependency failure without installing software implicitly
materialRisks: loose parsing can misattribute scores
vendor-specific renderer paths reduce portability
copied findings may carry unsupported claims into a polished document

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Inspect an agent capability installation against an explicit manifest and report availability, integrity, version evidence, missing bindings, and safe remediation options.
neutralIntentExamples: audit an agent capability installation against a declared manifest
show capability availability, integrity, missing bindings, and safe remediation options
operations: resolve expected locations, inspect entrypoints, count discovered capabilities, compare versions and hashes, and report binding gaps
outputs: read-only capability doctor report with exact evidence and remediation choices
failureBehavior: report permission and integrity failures separately and avoid treating a directory as a valid installation
exclusions: claiming readiness from hard-coded expected counts
usefulInvariants: manifest expectations remain separate from observed state
actual entrypoints and hashes determine availability
materialRisks: the source recommends unsafe pipe-to-shell installation
hard-coded paths and counts become stale
presence checks alone miss corrupted capabilities

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Summarize an agency workspace into current pipeline, commercial, capability, activity, and follow-up indicators while separating observed facts from estimates.
neutralIntentExamples: show current pipeline health and follow-up needs while separating facts from estimates
summarize agency operations from prospect, proposal, activity, and capability evidence
operations: inventory artifacts, deduplicate prospects, reconcile proposals and activity, compute bounded metrics, inspect capability availability, and surface attention items
outputs: read-only operational dashboard with evidence counts, estimates, alerts, and next actions
failureBehavior: show unavailable metrics and partial evidence explicitly instead of substituting silent estimates
exclusions: counting filename presence as a closed sale
presenting inferred revenue as accounting truth
usefulInvariants: facts and fallback estimates remain labeled
stale and unpaired work remains visible
materialRisks: file naming can distort metrics
activity heuristics can misclassify active clients
commercial estimates can be mistaken for booked revenue

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Produce a rapid, explicitly shallow prospect screen from one bounded evidence fetch, using calibrated dimensions and a clear handoff to deeper assessment when warranted.
neutralIntentExamples: produce a shallow scorecard with blind spots and a handoff to deeper assessment
screen a prospect rapidly from one bounded evidence retrieval
operations: perform one evidence retrieval, score only observable signals, state blind spots, calculate a composite, and identify bounded next checks
outputs: compact prospect snapshot with per-dimension evidence, uncertainty, quick improvements, and deep-audit recommendation
failureBehavior: report unreachable or evidence-poor targets and lower confidence rather than compensating with additional unapproved research
exclusions: legal or reputation conclusions from one page
usefulInvariants: reputation and compliance limitations are explicit
materialRisks: subjective scores can imply false precision
homepage evidence underrepresents reputation and compliance
speed pressure can reward shallow certainty

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Extract identity, ownership, control, tax, funding-source, and document-inventory fields from an authorized onboarding packet without making screening decisions or inventing missing values.
neutralIntentExamples: extract document-grounded identity and ownership fields from an authorized onboarding packet
produce a structured client-onboarding record with explicit missing and expired evidence
operations: inventory documents, extract supported fields with references, normalize dates and entities, and flag obvious missing or expired evidence
outputs: structured onboarding record plus a document-grounded gap inventory
failureBehavior: emit null and a gap record for unavailable or ambiguous fields and defer policy decisions to the screening rules layer
exclusions: performing sanctions or politically exposed person screening
using documents outside the authorized packet
usefulInvariants: every extracted fact traces to a document
inventory gaps remain separate from compliance outcomes
materialRisks: identity documents are highly sensitive
optical extraction errors can corrupt ownership data
a structured record can be mistaken for completed due diligence

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Represent an exact duplicate of the regulated onboarding extractor so the refinery preserves identity evidence without creating a second capability.
neutralIntentExamples: map this exact duplicate source to the canonical onboarding extractor
preserve duplicate provenance without synthesizing a second capability
inputs: exact duplicate source identity and body digest
operations: confirm byte identity and map the duplicate to the canonical reviewed capability
outputs: duplicate disposition referencing the regulated client onboarding extraction cluster
failureBehavior: reopen semantic comparison if the source body or capability contract diverges
usefulInvariants: exact duplicates retain separate source identities
only one canonical capability is synthesized
materialRisks: future upstream divergence can invalidate the duplicate decision

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Model a household financial plan across cash flow, retirement, goals, risk, tax, and scenarios while exposing every assumption and requiring qualified review for recommendations.
neutralIntentExamples: model a household financial plan with explicit assumptions and stress scenarios
surface cash-flow, retirement, goal, tax, and risk gaps for qualified review
inputs: documented economic, tax, return, and longevity assumptions
operations: reconcile financial facts, project cash flow and retirement scenarios, stress test goals, identify risk gaps, and rank proposed actions
outputs: assumption-labeled plan, scenario comparisons, projections, risk gaps, and review checklist
failureBehavior: block suitability claims and retain scenarios as incomplete when source data, jurisdiction, or qualified review is absent
usefulInvariants: stress cases accompany the base case
materialRisks: financial planning is high stakes
return and longevity assumptions can dominate outcomes
regulatory and tax rules change by jurisdiction

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Draft a jurisdiction-scoped business agreement or proposal from explicit party, scope, commercial, data, ownership, acceptance, liability, and termination requirements for qualified review.
neutralIntentExamples: draft a jurisdiction-scoped business agreement from explicit commercial requirements
prepare a reviewable proposal or contract with unresolved fields and legal-review gates
inputs: document type, jurisdiction, parties, authority, scope, value, dates, and special requirements
operations: select the correct agreement structure, preserve required unknowns, draft clauses, flag jurisdiction dependencies, and prepare a review checklist
outputs: editable document draft with unresolved fields, assumptions, jurisdiction warnings, and professional-review gate
failureBehavior: leave required fields explicit and defer consequential jurisdiction or enforceability questions to qualified counsel
exclusions: using stale legal assertions as current law
usefulInvariants: party and scope facts are explicit
jurisdiction and data-processing duties are surfaced
materialRisks: legal rules and enforceability claims are temporally unstable
template clauses can conflict with local law
users may mistake polished language for legal advice
